_about: Round 188 (Robert, 2026-11-08: 'There needs to be more variety in the martial arts and their special abilities for the type of skill it is'). Three arts for every kind of weapon, learned at skill 5, 15 and 30 of that weapon and used only with it in hand. They are arts like any other (scripts/systems/Arts.gd merges them; scripts/actors/ArtCaster.gd casts them): F or V, the quick keys R / F3 / F4 / F5, practice, mastery, branches. New ways of fighting for them: flurry, whirlwind, throw, volley, counter_stance, multi_bolt.

arts.name: Flowing Cut
arts.desc: A gliding lunge six metres forward that ends in a cut around you: 1.6x to everything within 2.6 m.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Thousand Petal Flurry
arts.desc: Six cuts in a single breath at whatever is in front of you (0.5x each), each with a 30% chance to strike true.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Mirror Stance
arts.desc: Raise the blade and wait: the next blow aimed at you in 1.6 seconds is turned aside and answered for 3.2x, staggering them.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Shadow Step
arts.desc: Vanish and step six metres (behind the nearest foe, if one is close), untouchable for a moment.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Viper Flurry
arts.desc: Seven quick stabs (0.4x each); the last leaves a cut that bleeds for most of what they dealt again.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Fan of Knives
arts.desc: A fan of thrown blades eleven metres ahead and three wide: 1.3x and a bleeding cut to all they find.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Crescent Moon
arts.desc: A wide crescent cut, 240 degrees and 4.2 m: 1.5x to everything it catches.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Cyclone Edge
arts.desc: Spin with the blade out for a second: five turns, 0.65x to everything within 3.2 m each turn, and you can still move.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Returning Crescent
arts.desc: Hurl the saber spinning ten metres out and back: 1.2x going, 1.2x coming home.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Dragon Thrust
arts.desc: A thrust that carries its qi seven metres through every foe in line: 2x, and they are driven back.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Vaulting Spear
arts.desc: Plant the spear and vault eight metres, landing point-first: 1.7x within 3 m and a stagger.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Hundred Points
arts.desc: Eight thrusts so fast they look like a hedge of points, 4.4 m straight ahead (0.45x each).
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Cleaving Arc
arts.desc: A downward cleave across 140 degrees: 1.7x, far more against the staggered and the armoured, whose plating it splits.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Whirling Axe
arts.desc: Four heavy turns with the axe out: 0.85x to everything within 3 m each turn, each cut bleeding.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Hurled Axe
arts.desc: Throw the axe twelve metres: it splits what it meets (1.8x) and spins back to your hand.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Earthbreaker
arts.desc: Bring the hammer down into the ground ahead: a shock of 3.6 m, 2.1x and a long stagger.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Meteor Drop
arts.desc: Leap high and fall hammer-first: 2.2x and a stagger within 4.2 m where you land.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Fault Line
arts.desc: Split the ground in a line ten metres long and three wide: 1.9x to all in it, thrown off their feet.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Reaping Sweep
arts.desc: A sweep almost all the way round, 4.8 m long: 1.4x to everything it reaches.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Hooking Pull
arts.desc: Hook a foe up to seven metres off and drag them to your feet, staggered (bosses are too heavy to move).
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Halberd Storm
arts.desc: Spin the halberd at full length: four turns, 0.8x within 4.4 m each, throwing them back.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Cloud Vault
arts.desc: Pole-vault seven metres and land with a sweep: 1.2x and a stagger within 2.4 m.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Monkey King's Flurry
arts.desc: Six spinning blows of the staff across a wide arc (0.5x each), each one rocking them.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Still Lake Stance
arts.desc: Hold the staff level and breathe: the next blow in 1.8 seconds is turned and answered for 2.6x, and your nanites cool by 25.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Hundred Fists
arts.desc: Nine blows in the time it takes to blink (0.32x each) on whatever stands in front of you.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Mountain Palm
arts.desc: An open palm that pushes the air itself five metres ahead: 1.9x and everything it hits is hurled back.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Flowing Water Stance
arts.desc: Empty hands, soft knees: the next blow in 1.5 seconds slides past you and is answered for 3x with a long stagger.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Rain of Arrows
arts.desc: Loose ten arrows high: they come down within 3.6 m of the foe you face, up to 22 m off (0.55x each).
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Piercing Gale Shot
arts.desc: One arrow on a gale of qi: 24 metres straight through everything in its path, 2.1x.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Scatter Shot
arts.desc: Five arrows at once, each to a different foe in front of you up to 16 m away (1x each).
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Bolt Barrage
arts.desc: Seven bolts cranked and loosed in a blur onto the foe you face (within 2.8 m, 0.8x each).
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Pinning Bolt
arts.desc: A heavy bolt that pins the foe you face to the ground for three seconds, 1.2x.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Siege Bolt
arts.desc: A bolt meant for gates: 28 metres through everything in line for 2.6x.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Spirit Orbs
arts.desc: Four orbs of ki that each find a foe of their own within 14 m, in any direction (1x each).
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Ki Lance
arts.desc: Gather the pool into one line of light: 18 metres through everything, 2x.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.

arts.name: Qi Nova
arts.desc: Let it all go at once: a nova of ki 5.2 m around you, 2x and a stagger.
arts.hint: It comes to anyone who fights long enough with that kind of weapon.
